scripts.verify: biome check . && bun run typecheck && bun run test:unit && bun run check:docs && bun run build
scripts.check:docs: d=$(mktemp -d) && cp docs/build-reference.py docs/grokbot-tools-and-api.json "$d" && python3 "$d/build-reference.py" >/dev/null && diff -q "$d/reference.html" docs/reference.html >/dev/null; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; [ $s -eq 0 ] || echo 'docs/reference.html is out of date: run python3 docs/build-reference.py' >&2; exit $s
scripts.build: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && bun run --cwd packages/grokbot-core build && bun run --cwd packages/grokbot-cli build && bun run --cwd packages/grokbot-mcp build
scripts.publish:all: bun run verify && for p in grokbot-core grokbot-cli grokbot-mcp; do (cd packages/$p && npm publish --access public --tag latest) || exit 1; done
